facts.where: README, section Model versions

facts.value: **What was actually true.** That arm was graded by `openai/gpt-6-astra`, and Astra is also a competitor on this board. We then re-graded all 11 arms with **one neutral judge**, `venice/gemini-3-8-flash`, from a family that is not graded anywhere on the board. Under that judge, Opus at max has **0 flagged inventions**. Its composite moves from 83.9 to 85.8, which is no longer last.
facts.where: CORRECTIONS.md, Correction 1: the judge bias; the 128k board uses one neutral judge for every arm
facts.quote: **What was actually true.** That arm was graded by `openai/gpt-6-astra`, and Astra is also a competitor on this board.
